changelog: Softchoice parser fix: recognize multi-period billing frequencies such as 'Every 3 Years' and prevent one line item from absorbing the next. Initial hub deployment. Vendor parsers for Softchoice (multi-group EA quotes, wrap-artifact tolerance, empty-SKU handling), SonarSource (3-tier discount pricing with custom xlsx layout), SAS Software, Smartsheet, and FastSpring/Iron Software. Automatic tax and delivery extraction. Aligned signature block, tuned column widths.
